name: Speko

team.summary: Founder Bek spent four years as cofounder and CTO building voice agents for enterprises across Asia in 10+ languages.

product.summary: Speko is a routing and benchmarking platform for Voice AI (STT, LLM, TTS) providing an API router and an open-source client-side gateway for voice agents.

market.summary: Developers and companies building production voice AI agents who need to optimize across multiple speech and language models.

risks.risk: Industry trend moving towards one-model end-to-end trained voice models rather than three-piece architectures (STT + LLM + TTS).
Developers often make model selection decisions once at the start of a project rather than dynamically routing every call.

founder_depth.why: Four years as cofounder and CTO building enterprise voice agents across multiple languages and regions.

shipping_evidence.why: Live hosted router platform, public benchmarks, open-source Go gateway binary on GitHub, and documented API integrations.

demand_signal.why: 118 points and 69 comments on HN with active user interest, customer stories, and 25% weekly usage growth since batch start.

defensibility.why: Built on proprietary benchmark data and automated scoring models for TTS naturalness, but faces potential commoditization and doubts on router value vs static choices.

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: Speko provides AI infrastructure and routing tools for voice AI developers.
analysis.case_summary: Strong domain expertise and live multi-model benchmarking tooling, but faces strategic questions on whether voice routing will endure as end-to-end multimodal models evolve.
would_change_my_mind: Widespread adoption of single end-to-end voice models replacing the three-tier STT/LLM/TTS architecture entirely
Evidence that developers prefer static single-vendor selections over dynamic routing in production
Significant enterprise retention and revenue generated purely from the routing layer vs the evaluation tools
data_gaps: Exact current revenue figures and number of paying customers
Detailed metrics on gateway download and self-hosted usage volume
